responsibility: Declares the string-based red-black tree data structures and APIs used by the rs6000 builtin generator. It defines node colors, node/root-sentinel layouts, and the public routines for creation, insertion, lookup, dumping, and inorder traversal, forming the interface contract consumed by rs6000-gen-builtins.cc and implemented in rbtree.cc.
same_name_distinction: Interface half of the rbtree pair: it defines the red-black tree node/root types, color enum, and public API declarations, whereas rbtree.cc provides the actual balancing and traversal implementation.
